audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly attributes wall-knockups to his Q ('Dodge his Q knockups', 'Get walled by his Q'). Ntofo Strikes does not do that.
audit.why: Kit file: Ntofo Strikes is a 450-range line on 3.5s that slows, and at 2 stacks fires a shockwave that PULLS enemies in. The knockback-and-stun is Path Maker (W), 600 range on 14/13/12/11/10s, which charges up taking reduced damage and lands true damage. The ability that launches you through a wall is All Out (R) on 120/100/80s, which also heals him and cuts his defenses. A Mordekaiser with no dash who saves Flash for the wrong ability dies to the right one.
audit.corrected: report[5].t, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d now name the right ability for each effect with its real cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Grievous Wounds and no note that Path Maker's damage is true.
audit.why: All Out heals him through your aura grind, and Path Maker's true damage means Plated Steelcaps does nothing against his engage — two flagged interactions the page never mentioned.
audit.corrected: report[8].t now carries the anti-heal timing and the true-damage caveat.

notes: Biggest sample in the slice (1370 games) and five of seven chart rows were inverted on both layers; fixed in matched pairs.
